note: The auditor agent's ranked list of bugs, data problems and code-quality work (agents/auditor.md).

items.title: ready_count compared timestamps as strings
items.detail: history.ready_count compared ISO strings, wrong if offsets differ (+05:30 vs +00:00). Now parses datetimes.

items.title: variety.py duplicate-topic cutoff compares ISO strings
items.detail: Same string comparison at generator/variety.py:94. Guard blocks the auditor from variety.py; owner to change.

items.title: fact_value showed 9.996 as '9.' and -0.5 as '0.5'
items.detail: Split decimals before rounding, so a value that rounds up lost its digits and kept a trailing dot; int() dropped the sign of values between -1 and 0. Now rounds to 2 places first.

items.title: emi crashed at 0% interest (no-cost EMI)
items.detail: Both the maths kind and the number check's independent formula divided by zero when rate_pct is 0, a real Indian offer and a likely trap-alert story. Now principal / months.

items.title: Zero amounts give bare ZeroDivisionError / math domain error
items.detail: lumpsum/sip/card_min_due with amount 0 (ratio = final/0, nice_axis(0)) fail with an unhelpful message instead of a writer-facing one. Writer error only; validate inputs > 0 in maths.compute.

items.title: Event specs {'end': 0} rejected and {'word': -1} means first word
items.detail: _event_time tests spec.get('end') for truthiness, so end 0 raises; negative word indices clamp to 0 rather than counting from the end as a writer would expect.

items.title: check_script and build repeat the per-beat resolve/fill/spoken steps
items.detail: Both compute maths, facts, figures, check beat ids and fill each beat. Extract one _prepare(script) returning results, figures, sources, beats. Deferred: the owner rewrote build.py on 2026-10-17 (3-day rule).

items.title: Watchdog crashed every hour once Scout/Studio reported run times
items.detail: scheduleCheck passed every AgentActivity with start/finish to scheduleOverlap, which looks each id up in SCHEDULE. 'scout' and 'studio' are not there, so entry(id).ist threw a TypeError before any notification was raised or resolved. Since the first timestamped Scout report (2026-10-18) the watchdog did nothing. Now unscheduled runs are skipped (isScheduled).

items.title: Workflow failures are hidden by '| tee' without pipefail
items.detail: data-audit, ingest, market, publish, stats and watchdog run 'npm run x | tee ...' under the default 'bash -e' shell, which has no pipefail, so a crashed job shows green and the watchdog's workflow-failure check never fires. Workflows are owner-only: raised as a notification.

items.title: ingestedAt picked the newest manifest by string order
items.detail: buildRoutineSettings sorted createdAt strings; with mixed UTC offsets the text order isn't time order (same class as gen-001). Now compared as instants (newestStamp). All manifests use +00:00 today, so no wrong value has shipped.

items.title: watchdog.ts computes the IST hour and weekday by hand in two places
items.detail: pipelineChecks and agentChecks repeat the istHour formula, and agentChecks repeats the 330-minute offset for the weekday. One istClock(now) helper next to istDay in lib would remove three copies. Small; for a later night (needs a test first).
